title: Aharon N NDE 4828
content: On 5th May 1999, at my work in the University of Tel-Aviv, I had a severe heart attack. I was taken to the clinic at work. I was lucky to have a doctor there. She gave me aspirins and oxygen by pressure and called an ambulance. The ambulance was late. I was losing consciousness. I was told that the ambulance had arrived. The doctor and medics started life saving procedures. Before I completely lost my consciousness, I prayed to God: 'Oh God! I am so close to you, then take me to you.' I said twice this sentence; and I was out!! I was in a transparent, luminescent balloon of bliss, floating inside like a baby in a mother's womb. However, I saw myself what I was. I experienced a wonderful feeling of bodilessness, no burden of weight, no measure of time, distance and space. In that transcendent balloon, I was fully conscious of my being and could feel what's beyond this transparent balloon. What I saw and felt is beyond my expression. During this state, I again pleaded God: 'I am so near you, please take me to you!' After this plea, all of a sudden, images of my wife and children started coming to me. I can't explain what my thoughts were, when I saw them. I only know that I slipped from this luminescent balloon, like a baby slipped from a mother's womb to take birth. I suddenly found the doctor and a medic waking me up. They said, 'Aharon, we saved you.'

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A 'transparent, luminescent balloon of bliss' (womb-like), which he later 'slipped from' like birth.

environment.environment_other_detail: A transparent, luminescent balloon of bliss; womb-like.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Prayer to God; experience of being in a 'transparent, luminescent balloon of bliss' and then 'slipping' out of it back to the body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Transitional 'balloon' state (womb-like) without tunnel/light-being/life review; then return triggered after images of wife and children.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experienced being inside a 'transparent, luminescent balloon of bliss' like a baby in a mother's womb, then 'slipped' from it like birth to return.
